name: Arcane Feedback
summary: In Ironforge, human acolytes seeking deeper teaching are sent back to Stormwind. There, the Cathedral of Light holds the traditions of their people.

sections.title: A Gentle Redirection
sections.body: High Priest Rohan welcomes a human priest who seeks deeper spiritual teaching in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward. Dwarven and human priests both serve the Holy Light, yet each people keeps its own rites, disciplines, and prayers of defense. Rohan reserves Ironforge’s teachings for his own clergy. So he sends human priests back to Elwynn to learn the traditions of humankind.

sections.title: Return to the Cathedral
sections.body: After reaching Stormwind City, the acolyte finds High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light. Laurena is relieved that Rohan’s guidance has brought the traveler to her, and welcomes them as their powers begin to grow. In the Cathedral, human priests can keep learning Stormwind’s spiritual practices. There they prepare to wield the Holy Light against the threats around the kingdom.

faq.q: Why does High Priest Rohan refuse to teach human priests?
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan respects human practitioners, but dwarven clergy keep rites and blessings passed down through their own people. He sends human priests to Stormwind, where their mentors preserve those teachings.
High Priestess Laurena leads and trains priests in Stormwind City’s Cathedral of Light. She guides promising human priests through their intermediate studies and rites.

faq.q: Where can High Priest Rohan be found?
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan can be found in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Intermediate human priests are sent from dwarven lands to the Cathedral of Light, their main place of racial training. There they can pursue spiritual teachings shaped for their people.

angles.text: As a priest, you learn that each people follows the Holy Light through its own traditions.
As a human priest, you are sent from dwarven sanctuaries to Stormwind. At the Cathedral of Light, you learn the sacred ways taught to your people.
As a dwarf, you honor your alliance with humans while keeping Khaz Modan’s specific rites among your own people.
